text: The parties agree that the agreement, its schedules and its appendices constitute the entire understanding between them. The licensee shall not assign, transfer or sublicense any of the rights granted herein without the prior written consent of the licensor. In the event of a breach, the non-breaching party may terminate this agreement upon written notice, and it will not be entitled to any further remedy beyond the express terms set out below. Nothing in this clause shall be read to limit, exclude or modify any mandatory provision of applicable law.

This policy applies to all employees, contractors and consultants who handle personal data. The controller may process, store and transfer personal data only where a lawful basis exists. Employees must not disclose, copy or share such data outside the scope of their duties. Where a data subject objects, the controller will review the request promptly, and it will respond within the statutory window. This policy does not create, vary or terminate any contract of employment.
